name: Beef Caldereta
assumptions: Yield estimated from 2kg beef plus vegetables and sauce volume, typical for 6 adult servings in Filipino beef stews.
Minutes estimated from instruction steps: saute (5min) + pressure cook (30min) + pan-fry veggies (10min) + final simmer (7min) + prep time (~8min).
Beef stock assumed as 1 Knorr beef cube (common in recipe).
Chilli powder '5' interpreted as 5g total based on provided data.
Tomato puree treated as canned tomato product (no added dairy/egg).
Soy sauce introduces wheat/soy ambiguity without brand certification.
No explicit tree nuts, fish, shellfish, eggs, milk, or sesame in listed ingredients.
instructions:
0.	Heat oil in a cooking pot. Saute onion and garlic until onion softens
1.	Add beef. Saute until the outer part turns light brown.
2.	Add soy sauce. Pour tomato sauce and water. Let boil.
3.	Add Knorr Beef Cube. Cover the pressure cooker. Cook for 30 minutes.
4.	Pan-fry carrot and potato until it browns. Set aside.
5.	Add chili pepper, liver spread and peanut butter. Stir.
6.	Add bell peppers, fried potato and carrot. Cover the pot. Continue cooking for 5 to 7 minutes.
7.	Season with salt and ground black pepper. Serve.
